sources_considered.why: The author's site could not be read because of a certificate error.
An institutional reproduction of the complete dated essay was readable.

evidence_items.publisher: Richard Sutton; reproduced by the University of Texas at Austin
evidence_items.locator: Page 1, opening paragraph; also page 2, paragraph summarizing the historical observations
evidence_items.explanation: The essay distinguishes short-term improvements from long-run dominance. Its later summary expressly acknowledges that building knowledge into agents helps initially, contradicting the attribution that hand engineering never produces progress.

unresolved_gaps: This assessment does not settle whether Sutton's narrower long-run generalization is itself overstated.
